summary: Sequoia NF lookout on Jordan Peak: 1934 cabin on a 20-foot steel tower, destroyed by the SQF Complex Fire in 2020, replaced by a new metal tower listed as New 2026.

facts.design: Original 1934 Region 1 cabin with a modified L-4 style cab on a 20-foot steel tower, enclosed with metal siding in 1970; the 2026 replacement is a new metal lookout described as honoring 1936 designs
facts.status_note: The original 1934 lookout was destroyed by the SQF Complex Fire on September 14, 2020; a replacement metal tower is listed as New 2026.

access.note: Original lookout was accessible only by trail and was open to the public per a 2013 page; access to the 2026 replacement is not confirmed in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: Reachable only by trail, per the National Historic Lookout Register (describes the original structure).

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Sequoia National Forest, Tule River Ranger District)

Returned to active service in 2001 and registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on June 10, 2001.
Page last updated March 1, 2013 reports staffing five days a week, closed Wednesday and Thursday, and open to the public.
Destroyed by fire during the SQF Complex Incident, September 14, 2020.
Added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register on September 15, 2020.
New metal lookout tower on Jordan Peak, reported by the design-build firm and listed by the FFLA as New 2026.

corrections.why: The register and the Former Fire Lookout Sites record show the original was destroyed in 2020. The standing structure is the replacement.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Former Fire Lookout Sites record give 9,038 ft (2,755 m); fire-lookouts.org gives 9,122 ft. The story reports both.
The register and fire-lookouts.org date the current structure to 1934. The 2026 design-build firm refers to original 1936 designs. The story keeps 1934 and reports the firm's wording.

notes_for_editor: Current status rests on two sources (the design-build firm's post, dated about one month before this run by its own label, and the FFLA list entry New 2026); no Forest Service page or news report on the completed tower was read, so the completion date is not confirmed beyond 2026. The 2013 staffing and access claims are from a page last updated March 1, 2013 and are not current. The brief's 'New 2026' came from the FFLA row for Jordan Peak and is verified. Yore Sequoia, abc30, and the Forest Service trail page appeared only as search snippets and were not quoted. A YouTube video of the new tower exists (search snippet only, not read). Elevation conflicts: 9,038 ft per NHLR and FFLOS, 9,122 ft per fire-lookouts.org. The brief's 'burned' event is supported by FFLOS (2020 SQF Complex Fire) and NHLR (destroyed September 14, 2020). No photos added.
